partners.mechanism_chain: Causal variant in CACNA1C (rs72751307) —DISRUPTS→ CACNA1C (HGNC:1427); CACNA1C (HGNC:1427) —DECREASES→ Cardiac action potential (GO:0003010); Cardiac action potential (GO:0003010) —LEADS_TO→ Long QT syndrome 5 (HP:0030126); Causal variant in RYR2 (rs137852760) —DISRUPTS→ RYR2 (HGNC:10177); RYR2 (HGNC:10177) —INCREASES→ Calcium ion homeostasis (GO:0006887); Calcium ion homeostasis (GO:0006887) —INCREASES→ Cardiac action potential (GO:0003010); Cardiac action potential (GO:0003010) —LEADS_TO→ Ventricular tachycardia (HP:0011674).
